latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release of the find-skills skill for OpenClaw.

- Enables searching and discovering OpenClaw skills from multiple sources (ClawHub, OpenClaw Directory, LobeHub Marketplace, GitHub, forums)
- Provides usage guidance, search strategies, source links, and troubleshooting tips
- Lists common categories and related skills for easy browsing
- Includes best practices and installation advice for finding and evaluating new skills
